# Limited name-based matching may produce false negatives

Name matching uses token-set Jaccard and is only considered when candidate and target share a related_component. This token-based, component-scoped approach can fail to match semantically similar names that do not share tokens or component scope.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/normalize.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.normalize.name_similarity`
- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/normalize.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.normalize._Normalizer._match_or_mint`
